description: This file defines the EmployeeContactDetailsController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It manages the rendering of employee contact details, including setting up Vue.js components and permissions based on the request parameters. It extends functionality from a base view controller and interacts with services like CountryService.

classes.name: EmployeeContactDetailsController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling employee contact details view, setting up Vue component, and permissions based on employee number.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue component for rendering the employee contact details page based on the request. Initializes component properties such as employee number and country list, and sets permissions.

methods.description: Returns the data groups used for capability checks related to contact details.
